name: analyze_trace
description: Perform a complete performance analysis on a Perfetto trace. Auto-loads the trace, runs diagnostic SQL queries, analyzes GPU counters and thread states, and returns a structured performance report with identified bottlenecks. If session_id is omitted, uses the most recently captured trace. Focus areas: 'overview' (default, full analysis), 'gpu', 'cpu', 'frames', 'threads'.

focus.description: Analysis focus area: 'overview' (default — full analysis), 'gpu' (GPU metrics only), 'cpu' (CPU + thread analysis), 'frames' (frame timing only), 'threads' (thread state only).

session_id.description: The file name of the trace (session ID). If omitted, uses the most recently captured trace.
